title: Subprocess Venv Staging and Adversarial GenAI Red-Teaming Architecture

claims.assertion: External frameworks with heavy optional ML dependencies (pyrit, azure-ai) must remain uninstalled in core env and staged lazily via subprocess runners (Rule 7).
claims.evidence: PyritSubprocessRunner stays in DISCOVERED/simulation mode without cold-start timeouts or module import crashes in CI.

claims.assertion: Subprocess transports must drain stderr ring buffers and close stdin pipes inside finally blocks to prevent proactor pipe exhaustion and OS buffer deadlocks (Rule 14, Rule 56).
claims.evidence: PyritSubprocessRunner.execute_probe implements asynchronous stderr drainage task with bounded ring buffer and loopback preservation.
